notes: Copula placed on `אֵימָה` as the predicate of the verbless clause, `סְבִיבוֹת שִׁנָּיו` being a construct nominal subject; the ASV's own margin ('His teeth are terrible round about') shows the clause read the other way, and that competing reading is named in the unit note.
'Round about' kept whole on `סָבִיב`, headed on 'Round', per rule 40's ruling and corpus count.
